blockingIssues.description: `eval:perf:check` only compares `fixture.sourceFiles` plus selected `metrics.*` fields. It never validates `schemaVersion`, `fixture.name`, `fixture.searchQuery`, or `fixture.aiSearchQuery`, and `readEvalPerfBaseline()` later accepts the baseline via an unchecked JSON cast. That means the command can still pass after fixture/query/schema drift, which violates the requirement that this tooling guard a fixed fixture dataset and schema-stable JSON output.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update the mission command list when new validation-facing commands land so scrutiny and user-testing workers can rely on AGENTS.md and services.yaml staying aligned.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Mission AGENTS.md:18-22 lists only check/test/ci/smoke commands, while /root/projects/nya2/.factory/services.yaml defines `eval_perf: bun run eval:perf` and `eval_perf_check: bun run eval:perf:check`.
